title: ILHEP : Effect of perioperative Intravenous Lidocaine on postoperative opioid related-side effects after open HEPatectomy: a multicentre prospective randomized controlled study
official: ILHEP : Effect of perioperative Intravenous Lidocaine on postoperative opioid related-side effects after open HEPatectomy: a multicentre prospective randomized controlled study
summary: Main objective: To compare the effects of a perioperative lidocaine infusion with that of placebo on postoperative opioid related side effects after open hepatectomy.
conditions: Postanesthetic complications in patients undergoing open hepatectomy
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Age ≥ 18 years
2. Undergoing a scheduled surgery for open hepatectomy
3. Effective contraception in accordance with CFTG recommendations
4. Having received oral and written information about the protocol and having signed a consent form to take part in this research
5. Affiliated to a social security scheme
Exclusion criteria:
1. Weight > 100 kg
2. Obstructive sleep apnoea syndrome
3. Severe hepatic insufficiency (Prothrombin Ratio < 15%)
4. Patient with an ongoing opioid medication that will blur the results
5. Adults under legal protection (safeguard of justice, curatorship, guardianship), persons deprived of their liberty, pregnant or breast-feeding women, minors, persons unable to express their consent, persons hospitalised for a different reason
6. Known participation in other interventional research (RIPH1 or RIPH2)
7. Allergy or contra-indication to lidocaine or one of its excipients and, in particular: 1) Treatment with following antiarythmic medication : class I, class III or Sotalol | 2) Heart failure NYHA grade 3-4, AV-block >1, without pacemaker | 3) Acute porphyria | 4) Uncontrolled epilepsy / Seizure at enrollment
8. Allergy to one of the drugs used for anaesthesia or one of their excipients
9. Nefopam contraindication and, in particular: 1) Renal insufficiency (Creatinine clearance < 50 mL/min) | 2) Inflammatory bowel disease | 3) Allergy
10. Ketoprofen contraindication and, in particular: 1) Untreated glaucoma | 2) Uncontrolled epilepsy | 3) Allergy
11. Urgent surgery
12. Transplant surgery or transplanted patients
13. Surgery with planned regional anaesthesia
14. Patient with a preoperative Sp02 < 95%
